senses.gloss: (I)--a sage who knows the yoga power of विष्णु. भा. II. 7. ४४. [page२-089+ २९]

(II)--a son of अम्शुमन् and of यशोदा; father of भगीरथ; tried to bring down the गन्गा but died with- out success.
1: भा. IX. 9. 2. M. १२. ४४; १५. १९. वा. ७३. ४२. ८८. १६७. Vi. IV. 4. ३४-5.
After a long rule, he retired to the forest.
2: Br. III. १०. ९२; ५६. २९, ३२; ६३. १६६.
(III)--a son of ऋष्य and father of प्रतीप. भा. IX. २२. ११.
(IV)--(खट्वाङ्ग) the son of कृशशर्म; comes down from heaven and resides here for a मुहूर्त; a master of the three worlds by intelligence and honesty. Br. III. ६३. १८२.
(VI)--a son of भीमसेन and father of प्रतीप. M. ५०. ३८; वा. ९९. २३३; Vi. IV. २० 7-8.
